name: Selangor Marathon 2026
short_description: Selangor Marathon 2026 is a full and half marathon held on November 1, 2026, in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Selangor Marathon 2026 (SELMAR 2026) is a full marathon and half marathon event scheduled for November 1, 2026, in Cyberjaya, Selangor, Malaysia. Organized by Tourism Selangor, the race starts at Persiaran Flora and offers runners a choice between the 42.195km full marathon and the 21.1km half marathon. Registration for the event is currently open.

faqs.question: When is the Selangor Marathon 2026?

faqs.question: Who organizes the Selangor Marathon 2026?
